result.audit_criteria: WebTrust Principles and Criteria for Certification Authorities – SSL Baseline with Network Security v2.6
qualifications: Subordinate CA certificates, CA131100001 and CA131100002, were issued without conforming to the Baseline Requirements: CRL Distribution Point extension does not contain the HTTP URL of the CA's CRL services; Authority Information Access extension does not present; Extended Key Usage extension does not present; Authority Key Identifier extension contains the authorityCertIssuer and authorityCertSerialNumber field. These caused WebTrust Principles and Criteria for Certification Authorities – SSL Baseline with Network Security v2.5, Principle 2, Criterion 2.4 to not be met.

Seventeen (17) subscriber certificates were issued without verified Subject Distinguished Name such as localityName, stateOrProvinceName, and organizationalName. Twenty (20) subscriber certificates were issued with presented organizationalUnitName. These caused WebTrust Principles and Criteria for Certification Authorities – SSL Baseline with Network Security v2.6, Principle 2, Criterion 2.2 to not be met.

Thirteen (13) OV certificates were issued without verified organization's ownership, control, or right to use the domain name included in Subject Alternative Name. These caused WebTrust Principles and Criteria for Certification Authorities – SSL Baseline with Network Security v2.6, Principle 2, Criterion 2.4 to not be met.
